::: {.ace-intro}
Audit Clinical Evidence (ACE) exists to protect the credibility of the scientific record. We audit published clinical research for errors and signs of falsification, fabrication, manipulation, and misconduct. If it slipped past peer review, we find it. We document it. We publish it. We report it.
:::
